Class or token-level cross-entropy loss.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Training](../categories/training.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `CrossEntropyLoss`, `CrossEntropy` |
| Search words | crossentropy, cross entropy, ce, classification, multiclass, token loss, sequence, ner, criterion, objective, optimization, loss |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Logits** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Class logits [N,C] or token logits [N,T,C] |
| **Labels** | Labels | Yes | 1 | Class labels [N] or token labels [N,T] |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Loss** | Loss | Yes | 1 | Loss value |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| reduction | `reduction` | Choice | `mean` | `mean`, `sum`, `none` | The run | Reduction. |
| ignore_index | `ignore_index` | Integer | `-100` |   | The run | Padding label ignore index. |
| label_smoothing | `label_smoothing` | Number | `0.0` |   | The run | Label smoothing. |
| class_weight | `class_weight` | Choice | `none` | `none`, `manual`, `balanced` | The run | Class weight mode. |
| class_weights | `class_weights` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Manual per-class weights. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: CrossEntropyLoss is a training loss node; PipelineExecutor loss execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as the loss |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Tips

- Don't apply Softmax before this loss.
- Use class weights for imbalanced datasets.
